heading_2: Check out our growing list of capabilities
body_1: We are innovators at our core, constantly evolving to meet market demands and pioneering new micro-manufacturing technologies.
body_2: Fast-turn prototype paths with DFM feedback so design teams get real parts on compressed timelines.
body_3: 4-axis CNC milling and drilling for fine-feature metals and engineering plastics at ±10 µm tolerances.
body_4: Micro-holes down to a single micron in almost any substrate: vias, nozzles, filters and dense arrays.
body_5: UV and IR laser processing for ultra-fine features in metals, polymers, glass, ceramics and thin films.
body_6: Micro-scale additive manufacturing for intricate geometries conventional processes can't reach.
